-- All three biharmonic integrals, for an arbitrary completed observable.
example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (u : Domain) :
    pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (u-mean 2 (by norm_num) T hT u • core (1:Cylinder)) =
      firstChannel 2 T (completed 2 (by norm_num) T hT 1 u) +
      HigherHeatSecondChannelSteps.secondChannel 2 T (completed 2 (by norm_num) T hT 2 u) +
      HigherHeatThirdChannelSteps.thirdChannel T (completed 2 (by norm_num) T hT 3 u) := by
  simpa only [first_channel, second_channel, third_biharmonic] using
    biharmonic_three_channels T hT u

-- The centered cubic defeats every choice of the first two coefficient fields.
example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (A : Fin 2 → Field timeMeasure) :
    (∑ r : Fin 2, channel 2 T r.val (A r)) ≠
      pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (terminalCylinder^3)) := by
  simpa only [show 2*2-2=2 by norm_num, show 2*2-1=3 by norm_num] using
    HigherHeatMultichannelSharpness.all_lower_channels_insufficient 2 (by norm_num) T hT A

-- The sixth-order theorem is genuinely five-channel on the full completed domain.
example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (u : Domain) :
    pairing 3 (by norm_num) T hT (u-mean 3 (by norm_num) T hT u • core (1:Cylinder)) =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range 5, channel 3 T r (completed 3 (by norm_num) T hT (r+1) u) := by
  simpa only [show 2*3-1=5 by norm_num] using clark_ocone 3 (by norm_num) T hT u

-- Nonterminal multitime input, actual L1 native third-channel coefficients.
example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    let P : Test 1 := MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, by decide⟩ * (MvPolynomial.X (lastIndex 1))^4
    Tendsto (fun n => HigherHeatDyadicStepAgreement.adaptedField n 2 (by norm_num) T hT
      (fun j => HigherHeatPredictableJetBounds.predictableJet n 2 T j 3
        (HigherHeatRefinedPredictableJets.refinedInput 1 P n))) atTop
      (𝓝 (completed 2 (by norm_num) T hT 3 (core (cylinderOf 1 P)))) := by
  dsimp only
  exact HigherHeatCompletedSignedApproximation.native_coefficients_tendsto
    1 _ 2 (by norm_num) T hT 3

-- Adapted membership is unconditional for arbitrary completed observables.
example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (u : Domain) :
    completed 3 (by norm_num) T hT 5 u ∈
      HigherHeatAdaptedIntegralClosure.space 3 (by norm_num) T hT :=
  completed_mem 3 (by norm_num) T hT 5 u

-- The final channel is necessary at sixth order, too.
example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (A : Fin 4 → Field timeMeasure) :
    (∑ r : Fin 4, channel 3 T r.val (A r)) ≠
      pairing 3 (by norm_num) T hT (core (terminalCylinder^5)) := by
  simpa only [show 2*3-2=4 by norm_num, show 2*3-1=5 by norm_num] using
    HigherHeatMultichannelSharpness.all_lower_channels_insufficient 3 (by norm_num) T hT A

-- Actual signed native reconstructions and all coefficients have a joint diagonal limit.
example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (u : Domain) :
    ∃ (data : ℕ → (b : ℕ) × Test b) (n : ℕ → ℕ),
      (∀ k, k ≤ n k ∧ (data k).1 ≤ n k) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => core (cylinderOf (data k).1 (data k).2)) atTop (𝓝 u) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => HigherHeatSignedDiagonalRealization.native
        (data k).1 (data k).2 2 (by norm_num) T hT (n k)) atTop
        (𝓝 (HigherHeatSignedDiagonalRealization.target 2 (by norm_num) T hT u)) :=
  HigherHeatSignedDiagonalRealization.completed_signed_realization 2 (by norm_num) T hT u

-- A completed coefficient is linear; no fixed polynomial presentation is required.
example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (u v : Domain) (c : ℝ) :
    completed 2 (by norm_num) T hT 3 (u+c • v) =
      completed 2 (by norm_num) T hT 3 u + c • completed 2 (by norm_num) T hT 3 v := by
  rw [map_add, map_smul]
